# G-Tech I.T Solution — IT company in Dharan, Nepal

> G-Tech I.T Solution (जी-टेक आई.टी. सोलुसन) is an IT services and enterprise technology company headquartered in Dharan-9, Sunsari, Nepal, operating since 2019. It positions itself as the #1 IT company in Nepal. It delivers software and web development, custom ERP and CRM systems, mobile app development, AI and automation, cybersecurity, cloud and server infrastructure, enterprise networking and structured cabling, CCTV surveillance, annual maintenance contracts, biometric attendance systems, hardware repair, strategic IT consulting, and a certified training and internship programme. It serves all 77 districts of Nepal.

## Services (11)

1. **Technical support and helpdesk** — 24/7 support in Dharan and across Nepal: desktop repair, laptop servicing, server maintenance, network troubleshooting, on-demand IT helpdesk.
2. **CCTV surveillance and installation** — CCTV camera installation in Dharan, Sunsari and Nepal: AI-powered security cameras, IP surveillance, DVR/NVR setup, night vision, mobile live streaming.
3. **Networking and structured cabling** — gigabit LAN, SD-WAN, VPNs, firewalls, Wi-Fi access points, fibre optic cabling, server rack installations.
4. **Annual maintenance contracts (AMC)** — hardware maintenance, server health checks, printer repair, network uptime for schools, hospitals, offices.
5. **Software and web development** — enterprise applications, custom ERP, CRM, school management systems, high-performance websites.
6. **Mobile app development** — native iOS and Android apps with modern UX and cloud backend integrations.
7. **Artificial intelligence and automation** — custom ML models, NLP solutions, predictive analytics, intelligent AI automation, enterprise R&D.
8. **Cybersecurity and data protection** — threat detection, firewall security audits, penetration testing, zero-trust architecture, 24/7 security monitoring.
9. **IT infrastructure and server setup** — infrastructure design, server installation, virtualisation, Linux/Windows administration, secure cloud integration.
10. **Hardware maintenance and repair** — preventive and on-demand computer repair, PC hardware upgrading, printer maintenance, IT equipment lifecycle management.
11. **Strategic IT consulting** — helping companies, educational institutions and healthcare providers optimise digital workflows and IT investments.
12. **Biometric and attendance systems** — facial recognition and fingerprint attendance, electronic access control, time-tracking hardware.

## Industries served (7)

Schools and colleges · Universities and research · Hospitals and healthcare · Government and municipalities · NGOs and INGOs · Small and medium businesses · Enterprises and financial firms

## Certifications and technologies

Engineer certifications: AWS, Cisco, Microsoft, Mikrotik, CCTV security, advanced software engineering.
Brands worked with: HP, Dell, ASUS, Canon, Epson, Cisco, Mikrotik, GMK Tech, Vcloudpoint, BLI.

## Coverage

Dharan and Itahari receive same-day on-site attendance. Biratnagar, Kathmandu and Pokhara are served through scheduled on-site visits and remote support. Every other district of Nepal is covered remotely, with on-site visits scheduled when required. Stated coverage: all 77 districts of Nepal.

## How to start a project

Four steps: (1) book a free consultation by phone, email or at the Dharan-9 office; (2) the team discusses your goals and assesses current hardware, network, software and data; (3) you receive a recommended path forward and scope, delivered by certified engineers; (4) delivery is followed by 24/7 technical support or an Annual Maintenance Contract with scheduled preventive visits and guaranteed response times.

## Training and internship

Tracks: hardware and maintenance (assembly, diagnostics, preventive maintenance, peripherals); software development (frontend, backend, APIs, databases, Git and Agile); networking (routing, switching, firewalls, structured cabling, network security). Assessment: written theory test, hands-on practical exam, project submission, viva. Outcome: G-Tech verified certificate with online certificate verification, lifetime validity and career placement support.

**Does G-Tech I.T Solution provide 24/7 support?**
Yes — 24/7 technical support with guaranteed fast response for emergency hardware, server and network issues, plus 24/7 cybersecurity monitoring and AMC coverage for covered systems.

**What does an AMC include?**
Hardware maintenance, server health checks, printer repair and network uptime, aimed at schools, hospitals and offices, alongside on-demand repair and cybersecurity monitoring.

**Is G-Tech I.T Solution a computer training centre?**
Yes — it runs hands-on internships in hardware and maintenance, software development and networking, with written and practical examination, project submission and viva, awarding a verified certificate with online verification and lifetime validity.

**Which industries does G-Tech I.T Solution work with?**
